dispute.claim_text: Fifty kilometres somehow became seventy. He followed 'the navigation' — whose navigation? Right at the end he suddenly got very warm and asked which country I was flying to. I know what that means. I've already reported it; I'm posting for others.

counterparty_statement.text: The app showed the CTE-ECP route and I took it. There was a jam near Marina so it re-routed me. I didn't add distance on purpose.
